column1: ## of scope: the doctor is the one who knows the patient.
## WHY THIS IS SAFE TO SHIP ON
##  - It only pre-fills a row the doctor is already writing
##    has left empty. Every cell stays editable and clears in one keystroke.
##  - The doctor's own saved default always wins over this file.
##  - It replaces a single hardcoded '1+1+1' / '5 days' that was applied to
##    every drug alike -- a PPI is 1+0+0 before food
##    night. Anything class-appropriate is strictly safer than that literal.
##    combination product never inherits a single-ingredient default.
##   Change any value and re-run  php artisan dosing-defaults:load
##   To stop a drug being pre-filled at all
##   that field then stays blank in the pad. Blank is honest -- the doctor
## ALLOWED VALUES (anything else is rejected by the loader
##   default_duration   3 days | 5 days | 7 days | 10 days | 14 days | 1 month | Continue
##   default_timing     after_food | before_food | empty_stomach | at_night | with_food
## `Continue` means a long-term medicine with no stop date on the pad.
## Blank in any column = no default; the doctor fills that cell himself.
